name: infranodus-plugins
description: InfraNodus plugins for Claude Code, Codex and Grok Build: automatic memory stored as a knowledge graph in your InfraNodus account, and the core InfraNodus graph tools. Each plugin lives in its own repository; this catalog only points at them. The skills have their own marketplace, infranodus/skills.

plugins.name: infranodus-memory
plugins.description: Automatic memory for coding agents, stored as a knowledge graph in your InfraNodus account: at the end of a session it saves what was learned about the project; at the first prompt of the next one it recalls it, plus a gap the memory does not cover yet. Commands: /infranodus-memory:{status,save,recall,optimize,forget-last,off,on}.

plugins.name: infranodus
plugins.description: [Also in infranodus/skills] Knowledge graph + gap finder for your notes, vault, repo or agent memory via the InfraNodus MCP server: topic clusters, content gaps, research questions, GraphRAG retrieval, SEO/GEO. Skip it if you already have infranodus@infranodus-skills.
